description: This file contains several UI component functions (Button, Card, Progress, Badge, Modal) that create and return DOM elements for use in a web application's user interface. The components are designed with accessibility and styling in mind and are exported for use elsewhere.

methods.name: Button({ label, onClick, variant = 'primary', type = 'button', attrs = {} })
methods.description: Creates and returns a themed button element with specified label, click handler, variant style, and additional attributes.

methods.name: Card({ title, body })
methods.description: Creates a section element with optional title and body content, which can be DOM nodes or text.

methods.name: Progress({ value = 0 })
methods.description: Creates a progress bar element with a specified value between 0 and 1, and provides a method to update it.

methods.name: Badge({ text })
methods.description: Creates a span element styled as a badge with specified text.

methods.name: Modal({ title, content, actions = [] })
methods.description: Creates a modal dialog overlay with a title, content, and action buttons, including close behavior on backdrop click.

ctags.name: Button
ctags.pattern: /^export function Button({ label, onClick, variant = 'primary', type = 'button', attrs = {} }) {$/
